detail.title: 屏幕、屏幕的制作方法及移动终端
detail.abstract: The present invention relates to the field of electronic technologies, and especially to a screen, a screen manufacturing method and a mobile terminal. The screen comprises a touch screen, an optical transparent adhesive layer and a display screen, wherein the optical transparent adhesive layer is arranged between the touch screen and the display screen and bonds the touch screen and the display screen together, and sealant is arranged at edges of the optical transparent adhesive layer. The screen manufacturing method comprises the following steps: bonding the touch screen and the display screen together with an optical transparent adhesive, and after the optical transparent adhesive is cured, forming the optical transparent adhesive layer between the touch screen and the display screen; and arranging the sealant at the edges of the optical transparent adhesive layer. The mobile terminal comprises a screen, wherein the screen is the aforementioned screen. The screen and the mobile terminal that the screen is applied to provided by the embodiments of the present invention have the advantages of getting rid of the influence of sweat (or other liquid) and dirty things (comprising dust) on screen display colors. The screen manufacturing method provided by the present invention is simple and convenient to implement.
